system.description: Shadows drift to you unbidden, wrapping around you like a restless cloak even when you have no wish to call upon Obtenebration. You can never pass for "normal," and your unnatural aspect unsettles even other Cainites. You suffer a penalty on Social challenges made in the presence of anyone who can see you clearly, and Lasombra in particular find your inability to master your own shadows to be a mark of weak will.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book One: Magisters
